title: PERSONNEL AND HIRING COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the Los Angeles Police Department (LAPD) hiring process.
text:
[Council File 25-0601]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
PERSONNEL AND HIRING COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the Los Angeles Police Department (LAPD) hiring process.
Recommendation for Council action:
NOTE and FILE the September 16, 2026 joint Personnel Department and Chief Legislative Analyst (CLA) report relative to the LAPD hiring process.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Not applicable
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council notes and files a September 16 joint Personnel Department and CLA report on the Los Angeles Police Department hiring process, taking no further action.

details.action: note and file report on LAPD hiring process
